subject: Game Theory
title: Rebuilding Trust
description: Learn Rebuilding Trust in one minute.

hook.text: After South Africa's apartheid ended, the nation built a Truth and Reconciliation Commission instead of courts.

buildup.text: Rebuilding trust requires more than stopping harm. It demands acknowledgment, accountability, and visible change.

discovery.text: Research shows trust repairs fastest with a sequence: apology, explanation, penance, then consistent good behavior.

twist.text: But some betrayals are too deep. Studies show competence failures are forgiven faster than integrity failures.

climax.text: Germany rebuilt trust after WWII through decades of reparations, education reform, and consistent democracy.

punchline.text: Trust breaks in a moment, rebuilds over years.

quiz.question: Which type of failure is harder to recover from?
